paragraphs: Go Vocal sells a community engagement platform that governments use to collect input from residents. The company states that its mission is to build stronger democracies by making public decision-making more inclusive, participatory, and responsive.

Agencies run surveys, voting, mapping and budgeting in one place rather than across separate departmental tools. Input gathered in person can be digitized, and speech can be converted to text. AI features are offered to organize responses and to build reports that can be shared with stakeholders.

The about page describes a global team of more than 50 local experts working with over 500 local governments and organisations across 20 countries. The company was founded in Belgium under the name CitizenLab, and its first pilot project was with the city of Hasselt. It describes itself as a B Corp certified SaaS company. Published case studies cover work with local governments in North America and Europe, including a participatory budgeting programme in Toronto Centre.
